findings.summary: Gimlet-L has a lower failure rate than Ostler on both Kiln-Py and Kiln-PyX.
findings.scope: Failure rate (%) on Kiln-Py and Kiln-PyX, greedy decoding, one sample per problem, 13B-parameter models.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; difference in means only.

findings.summary: Gimlet-S has a higher failure rate than Ostler on both Kiln-Py and Kiln-PyX.
findings.scope: Failure rate (%) on Kiln-Py and Kiln-PyX, greedy decoding, one sample per problem, 3B vs 13B parameters.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; difference in means only.

sentences.text: Gimlet-L achieved a lower failure rate than Ostler on both benchmarks, with 34.0% versus 38.8% on Kiln-Py and 68.9% versus 76.5% on Kiln-PyX.
In contrast, Gimlet-S had a higher failure rate than Ostler on both benchmarks, at 41.3% versus 38.8% on Kiln-Py and 78.1% versus 76.5% on Kiln-PyX.
These comparisons are based on mean failure rates under greedy decoding with one sample per problem, and no statistical tests were reported.
